newsitem.title: JAPAN: S&P sets "A" pi ratings to Chugoku, Daishi banks.
newsitem.headline: S&P sets "A" pi ratings to Chugoku, Daishi banks.

text.p: Standard & Poor's (S&P) said on Thursday it had assigned its "A" public information rating to two Japanese regional banks -- Chugoku Bank Ltd and Daishi Bank Ltd.
S&P also said that it had assigned "BBB" public information ratings to two other regional banks -- Juroku Bank Ltd and Bank of Kyoto Ltd.

The public information ratings, introduced by S&P in November, are identified by the "pi" symbol following the rating, indicating S&P employed analytical procedures that parallel its traditional credit ratings but are based on public disclosure and other sources of information.
